observed_sequence.action: The right forearm moves down and forward toward the outer image-left end flap of the open case; the left hand stays beside its opposite end.
The right fingers contact and close around the outer flap or edge. The main tool-bearing body remains on the table.
The right hand lifts the outer end into an upright bent flap while the case remains mostly flat on the table. The left hand remains at the other end without a visible grasp-and-lift.
The right hand brings the raised flap inward and down over the adjacent tool section, making a partial fold.
The right fingertips stay over and press the folded flap, settling it against the case; the left hand remains near the opposite edge.
The right fingers open and lift clear. The flap curls upward after the hand leaves; the tool-bearing case remains open.
The right arm withdraws above the tabletop. The left hand remains beside the case. The clip ends with the case partly folded rather than fully closed.
